<!-- Generated by `cargo run -p xtask -- gen-telemetry` from the crates' tests/recorded/ files and oxtel-semconv. Edit those, not this. -->

What each instrumentation crate records, under which names, so you can find them in your backend, write dashboards and alerts against them, or check them against what another language records. Every name is defined by the OpenTelemetry semantic conventions; descriptions are theirs. **Stable** names don't change. Names **in development** can change in a later release of the conventions, and oxtel follows them when they do.

Values that may hold personal or secret data, such as tool arguments, aren't recorded unless asked for, and aren't listed here.

## oxtel-tower

HTTP servers and clients built on tower, axum and hyper. A server span is named by its method and route, such as `GET /items/{id}`; a client span by its method alone. The server also writes a `request` log line as each request ends.

### Client spans

| Attribute | What it is | Stability |
|---|---|---|
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`error.type`</span> | Describes a class of error the operation ended with. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`http.request.method`</span> | HTTP request method. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`http.response.status_code`</span> | [HTTP response status code](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231#section-6). | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`network.protocol.version`</span> | The actual version of the protocol used for network communication. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`server.address`</span> | Server domain name if available without reverse DNS lookup; otherwise, IP address or UNIX domain socket name. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`server.port`</span> | Server port number. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`url.full`</span> | Absolute URL describing a network resource according to [RFC3986](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3986) | stable |

### Server spans

| Attribute | What it is | Stability |
|---|---|---|
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`error.type`</span> | Describes a class of error the operation ended with. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`http.request.method`</span> | HTTP request method. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`http.response.status_code`</span> | [HTTP response status code](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231#section-6). | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`http.route`</span> | The matched route template for the request. This MUST be low-cardinality and include all static path segments, with dynamic path segments represented with placeholders. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`network.protocol.version`</span> | The actual version of the protocol used for network communication. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`server.address`</span> | Server domain name if available without reverse DNS lookup; otherwise, IP address or UNIX domain socket name. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`server.port`</span> | Server port number. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`url.path`</span> | The [URI path](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3986#section-3.3) component | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`url.scheme`</span> | The [URI scheme](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3986#section-3.1) component identifying the used protocol. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`user_agent.original`</span> | Value of the [HTTP User-Agent](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html#field.user-agent) header sent by the client. | stable |

### Metrics

| Metric | Instrument | What it measures, and its labels | Stability |
|---|---|---|---|
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`http.client.request.duration`</span> | histogram, in `s` | Duration of HTTP client requests. Labels: `error.type`, `http.request.method`, `http.response.status_code`, `server.address`, `server.port`, `url.scheme`. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`http.server.active_requests`</span> | up-down counter, in `{request}` | Number of active HTTP server requests. Labels: `http.request.method`, `url.scheme`. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`http.server.request.duration`</span> | histogram, in `s` | Duration of HTTP server requests. Labels: `error.type`, `http.request.method`, `http.response.status_code`, `http.route`, `network.protocol.version`, `url.scheme`. | stable |

## oxtel-sql

SQLite through rusqlite, PostgreSQL through tokio-postgres and deadpool-postgres, and sqlx's pools. A span is named by its statement's summary: its operation and table, such as `SELECT orders`. The connection pool metrics come from deadpool-postgres and sqlx pools.

### Client spans

| Attribute | What it is | Stability |
|---|---|---|
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`db.namespace`</span> | The name of the database, fully qualified within the server address and port. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`db.query.summary`</span> | Low cardinality summary of a database query. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`db.query.text`</span> | The database query being executed. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`db.response.returned_rows`</span> | Number of rows returned by the operation. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`db.response.status_code`</span> | Database response status code. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`db.system.name`</span> | The database management system (DBMS) product as identified by the client instrumentation. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`error.type`</span> | Describes a class of error the operation ended with. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`server.address`</span> | Server domain name if available without reverse DNS lookup; otherwise, IP address or UNIX domain socket name. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`server.port`</span> | Server port number. | stable |

### Metrics

| Metric | Instrument | What it measures, and its labels | Stability |
|---|---|---|---|
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`db.client.connection.count`</span> | up-down counter, in `{connection}` | The number of connections that are currently in state described by the `state` attribute. Labels: `db.client.connection.pool.name`, `db.client.connection.state`. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`db.client.connection.max`</span> | up-down counter, in `{connection}` | The maximum number of open connections allowed. Labels: `db.client.connection.pool.name`. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`db.client.connection.pending_requests`</span> | up-down counter, in `{request}` | The number of current pending requests for an open connection. Labels: `db.client.connection.pool.name`. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`db.client.connection.timeouts`</span> | counter, in `{timeout}` | The number of connection timeouts that have occurred trying to obtain a connection from the pool. Labels: `db.client.connection.pool.name`. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`db.client.connection.use_time`</span> | histogram, in `s` | The time between borrowing a connection and returning it to the pool. Labels: `db.client.connection.pool.name`. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`db.client.connection.wait_time`</span> | histogram, in `s` | The time it took to obtain an open connection from the pool. Labels: `db.client.connection.pool.name`. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`db.client.operation.duration`</span> | histogram, in `s` | Duration of database client operations. Labels: `db.namespace`, `db.query.summary`, `db.response.status_code`, `db.system.name`, `error.type`, `server.address`, `server.port`. | stable |

## oxtel-rmcp

MCP servers and clients built with rmcp. A span is named by its method and, for a tool or prompt, its name, such as `tools/call add`.

### Client spans

| Attribute | What it is | Stability |
|---|---|---|
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`error.type`</span> | Describes a class of error the operation ended with. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.operation.name`</span> | The name of the operation being performed. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.tool.name`</span> | Name of the tool utilized by the agent. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`mcp.method.name`</span> | The name of the request or notification method. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`mcp.protocol.version`</span> | The [version](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/versioning) of the Model Context Protocol used. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`rpc.response.status_code`</span> | Status code of the RPC returned by the RPC server or generated by the client | in release_candidate |

### Server spans

| Attribute | What it is | Stability |
|---|---|---|
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`error.type`</span> | Describes a class of error the operation ended with. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.operation.name`</span> | The name of the operation being performed. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.tool.call.arguments`</span> | Parameters passed to the tool call. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.tool.call.result`</span> | The result returned by the tool call (if any and if execution was successful). | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.tool.name`</span> | Name of the tool utilized by the agent. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`jsonrpc.request.id`</span> | A string representation of the `id` property of the request and its corresponding response. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`mcp.method.name`</span> | The name of the request or notification method. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`mcp.protocol.version`</span> | The [version](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/versioning) of the Model Context Protocol used. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`network.transport`</span> | [OSI transport layer](https://wikipedia.org/wiki/Transport_layer) or [inter-process communication method](https://wikipedia.org/wiki/Inter-process_communication) . | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`rpc.response.status_code`</span> | Status code of the RPC returned by the RPC server or generated by the client | in release_candidate |

### Metrics

| Metric | Instrument | What it measures, and its labels | Stability |
|---|---|---|---|
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`mcp.client.operation.duration`</span> | histogram, in `s` | The duration of the MCP request or notification as observed on the sender from the time it was sent until the response or ack is received. Labels: `error.type`, `gen_ai.operation.name`, `gen_ai.tool.name`, `mcp.method.name`, `mcp.protocol.version`, `rpc.response.status_code`. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`mcp.server.operation.duration`</span> | histogram, in `s` | MCP request or notification duration as observed on the receiver from the time it was received until the result or ack is sent. Labels: `error.type`, `gen_ai.operation.name`, `gen_ai.tool.name`, `mcp.method.name`, `mcp.protocol.version`, `network.transport`, `rpc.response.status_code`. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`mcp.server.session.duration`</span> | histogram, in `s` | The duration of the MCP session as observed on the MCP server. Labels: `mcp.protocol.version`, `network.transport`. | in development |

## oxtel-genai

Calls to generative AI models. A span is named by its operation and the model asked for, such as `chat llama3.2`.

### Client spans

| Attribute | What it is | Stability |
|---|---|---|
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`error.type`</span> | Describes a class of error the operation ended with. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.conversation.id`</span> | The unique identifier for a conversation (session, thread), used to store and correlate messages within this conversation. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.embeddings.dimension.count`</span> | The number of dimensions the resulting output embeddings should have. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.operation.name`</span> | The name of the operation being performed. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.provider.name`</span> | The Generative AI provider as identified by the client or server instrumentation. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.request.choice.count`</span> | The target number of candidate completions to return. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.request.frequency_penalty`</span> | The frequency penalty setting for the GenAI request. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.request.max_tokens`</span> | The maximum number of tokens the model generates for a request. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.request.model`</span> | The name of the GenAI model a request is being made to. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.request.presence_penalty`</span> | The presence penalty setting for the GenAI request. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.request.seed`</span> | Requests with same seed value more likely to return same result. | in development |

| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.request.top_k`</span> | The top-K sampling setting for the GenAI request: restricts token generation at each step to the K most likely next tokens. | in development |

| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.response.id`</span> | The unique identifier for the completion. | in development |

| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk`</span> | Time to first chunk in a streaming response, measured from request issuance, in seconds. The value is measured from when the client issues the generation request to when the first chunk is received in the response stream. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.usage.input_tokens`</span> | The number of tokens used in the GenAI input (prompt). | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.usage.output_tokens`</span> | The number of tokens used in the GenAI response (completion). | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`server.address`</span> | Server domain name if available without reverse DNS lookup; otherwise, IP address or UNIX domain socket name. | stable |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`server.port`</span> | Server port number. | stable |

Labels: `gen_ai.operation.name`, `gen_ai.provider.name`, `gen_ai.request.model`, `gen_ai.response.model`, `gen_ai.token.modality`, `server.address`, `server.port`. | in development |
| <span data-pagefind-weight="7">`gen_ai.client.operation.duration`</span> | histogram, in `s` | GenAI operation duration. Labels: `gen_ai.operation.name`, `gen_ai.provider.name`, `gen_ai.request.model`. | in development |

## How this page is kept true

Each crate's tests run its instrumentation, check that every name it records is one the conventions define, with the conventions' instrument and unit, and keep the names in a file that the test fails on when they change. This page is generated from those files, and CI checks that it's up to date, so it can't list a name the code doesn't record, or miss one it does.

oxtel-tokio's metrics aren't in the conventions, which define none for tokio; [its documentation](https://docs.rs/oxtel-tokio) lists them.
